definition: A pack that composes a whole front: the rhythm of its bays, how its storeys graduate in height, and the balance of solid wall to opening.
basis: Our wording of the pack schema's facade-system kind. schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, kind description: "facade-system: bay rhythm, storey graduation, solid-to-void."; proportions/systems/facade-classical.json module.name: "One bay: the centre-to-centre spacing of the vertical rank of openings on the principal elevation".
